Name: (CP) No Surprise Crab
Author: Sinmenon
Description:
[center][img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/56f7bd5ec87cf20e4d4ff6762940f014/5b6a1b0540872cda-e6/s540x810/c07c8f3ffc21216261f75f7a02f88046b544742e.png[/img]﻿

[img]https://66.media.tumblr.com/a5a753da0ac80ad7747c7f1bc0f90e20/tumblr_pnyxkf5Aj61rs2gquo1_540.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]﻿
Tired of being surprised by the crab enemies at the Mines or the Skull Cavern?
It is just a simple edit to make it very easy to spot: there’s a weapon stuck on their back.﻿
I used LavenderLight's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2988]DIYCP Monster Marsh[/url] as template.
[center]
[img]https://64.media.tumblr.com/b4b1f400dfd96948ca910ade5d6e8070/522131cb40e77002-9e/s540x810/3346008ef7879aed51c3be305929e85792dd22b9.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿[/center][b]Update[/b]

Now it includes all the current mimic-like monsters.
- Rock crab (normal and dangerous)
- Lava crab (normal and dangerous)
- Iridium crab
- Stick bug
- False Magma Cap

[b]Update (6/38/2024)
[/b]Added the Truffle Crab from the 1.6 update!

[b]Mini-update (7/3/2024)[/b]
The game kept flagging it as not 1.6 but it is fixed now.
